source_findings.claim: The B12X gate ignores pipeline parallelism
source_findings.evidence: b12x_mxfp4_moe.py:596-603 _supports_parallel_config reads only use_ep, ep_size, use_all2all_kernels, enable_eplb; fused_moe/config.py:1190 derives use_ep = (dp*pcp*tp > 1) and enable_expert_parallel. pipeline_parallel_size appears in neither.

source_findings.claim: The target model supports PP but the MTP draft does not
source_findings.evidence: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM (deepseek_v2.py:1777-1779) implements SupportsPP; DeepSeekMTP (deepseek_mtp.py:223) subclasses only nn.Module and DeepseekV2MixtureOfExperts.
